question: Why do ritual worshippers return after heaven?
premises: They enjoy heaven then enter mortal world.
Their desire limits fruit to heaven.
Their own nature is not sacrifice's return.
inference: Limited desire causes return, not sacrifice itself.
uncertainties: Editorial numeral 22 is not verse wording.
plain_english: They enjoy vast heaven, then return to the mortal world when merit is exhausted; desire limits the fruit, so they come and go.
